ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
In June 2021, the national football team successfully advanced to the final round of the World Cup qualifiers after defeating Syria 3-1. During a dribbling attack by Wu Lei, the initial speed of the football was $v_0 = 4\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$, directed horizontally to the left; after being kicked, the speed of the ball became $v_1 = 6\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$, directed horizontally to the right. The mass of the ball is $m = 0.4\mathrm{kg}$, and the friction from the grass during the kick is negligible.

1. Find the magnitude of the change in momentum of the soccer ball during this process.
2. If the duration of this process is $0.2\mathrm{s}$, what is the average horizontal force exerted by the foot on the soccer ball?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In June 2021, the national football team successfully advanced to the final round of the World Cup qualifiers after defeating Syria 3-1. During a dribbling attack by Wu Lei, the initial speed of the football was $v_0 = 4\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$, directed horizontally to the left; after being kicked, the speed of the ball became $v_1 = 6\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$, directed horizontally to the right. The mass of the ball is $m = 0.4\mathrm{kg}$, and the friction from the grass during the kick is negligible. 1. Find the magnitude of the change in momentum of the soccer ball during this process. 2. If the duration of this process is $0.2\mathrm{s}$, what is the average horizontal force exerted by the foot on the soccer ball?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the attached figure, there is a foot kicking a soccer ball on grass/the ground; next to the soccer ball, an arrow marks the initial velocity as 4 m/s, with the direction horizontally to the left; the position after being kicked is represented by a dashed-line ball, and an arrow next to it marks the velocity as 6 m/s, with the direction horizontally to the right. The problem statement gives the soccer ball mass m=0.4 kg, the action time Δt=0.2 s, and the grass friction during the kicking process can be ignored. Then reason: take the horizontal rightward direction as the positive direction, then the initial velocity v_i=-4 m/s, and the final velocity v_f=+6 m/s. The change in momentum is Δp=m(v_f-v_i)=0.4×[6-(-4)]=0.4×10=4.0 kg·m/s, so the magnitude of the change in momentum is 4.0 kg·m/s. The average horizontal force is obtained from the impulse theorem F_avg=Δp/Δt, F_avg=4.0/0.2=20 N, with the direction to the right. The question only asks for the magnitude of the average horizontal force, therefore it is 20 N.
